fatal_blockers: The tested construction fails its own metric objective: all 204 solved dictionaries have worst YES 16 and best NO 16, giving ratio 1 and exponent 0 rather than a ratio above 25/9.

The exact construction is exponential in reduced-code dimension. The all-eight instance requires 33,554,431 row variables and 16,777,216 pointed constraints, and no polynomial-size analytic row family or polynomial-time separation oracle is supplied.

The hostile suite is materially incomplete: one YES, five NO, all twenty affine-closure instances, holonomy, and all-eight are unsolved. Results on the dimension-four subset cannot support any asymptotic hardness or general dense-fold claim.

The packet overstates verifier scope: “no kernel” is supported only as no pointed kernel, and “rank 64” is the output-coordinate/lattice rank recorded as len(coordinates), not the dimension of the image code. No relabeling-covariance test is present despite relabeling failure being a stated falsification condition.

The proposed next step is not one precise bounded experiment; it is conditional on first inventing and proving a polynomial analytic family and separation invariant. With the exact ILP already failing both separation and scalability, enlarging it has no justified payoff.
